subject: English
stimulus: (a) Acid rain is harmful because ⎯⎯. (b) The wind was so strong that ⎯⎯. (c) Had he been a little careful ⎯⎯. (d) They were frightened when ⎯⎯. (e) Take your umbrella lest ⎯⎯.
guide_solution: (a) Acid rain is harmful because it causes great harm to our environment mainly to our forests and lakes. (b) The wind was so strong that it blew away many of our thatched houses. (c) Had he been a little careful he could have saved his kid from being injured. (d) They were frightened when the thunder storm began. (e) Take your umbrella lest you should get drenched.
